name: prompting-wizard-teacher
description: Learn prompting through everyday work, with optional practice and portable Learning Cards. Native-app pilot.

interface.longDescription: An everyday teaching pilot: finish your work, choose practice, an example or a lesson, and keep accepted learning evidence in a manual Learning Card. No interview, background monitoring or automatic sync. Native-app compatibility requires a walkthrough.
defaultPrompt: Use Prompting Wizard to teach me through my work; no interview.
Use Prompting Wizard to review my attached Learning Card.
